newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The cabinet on Monday approved the proposal for forming a new company to finnce all major infrastructure projects in private sector, as per suggestion from the World Bank.
President Shahabuddin Ahmed said on Monday that the provision of the caretaker government was an "evidence of mutual distrust" among political parties in Bangladesh.
Dhaka has urged New Delhi to ensure the water flow of the Ganges river at the Frakka barrage point as per the sharing treaty signed in December.
Chiefs of border security forces of Bangladesh and India meet in New Delhi on Tuesday to discuss oustanding frontier issues.
The District and Session Judge on Monday indicted 20 people for the 1975 killing of independence leader Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and set April 21 for formal start of the trial.
Dhaka has backed a bid by the Non Alligned Movement (NAM) for a special UN session on Palestine problem.
Bangladesh has urged Australia to provide zero tariff for Bangladeshi goods as a measure to raise imports from Dhaka and thus reduce the gap in bilateral trade.
The government has decided to procure 200,000 tonnes of paddy and 120,000 tonnes of rice during the current harvesting season. REUTER
